reviews.text: I looked everywhere for a strong well built building because of my high wind area, well I found graceland builds are far superior than everything else in the market. Double studs every 4ft, double header, real wood siding that's not junk glued together ,and tornado clips !!!!  Delivery was fast and easy too !  Cant wait to wire and insulate it !!!
reviews.author: texastoad24

reviews.text:
Lance at Graceland portable building is,the most helpful sales person and customer service that I have ever met! Not only did he come and take my fence down for the delivery. Also we did it all over the phone. I didn’t have to leave my home which is hard for me to do anyway these days, he came back after it was all done and delivered, and put my fence back up ,so I’m happy with it. I have no complaint at this point ,so I did compare it a lot to another company’s,that I will not mention,but the thing I liked about Graceland is Lance’s Service as well as the metal brackets for the joist and the metal roof ,so to me that that meant a lot, as well as the flooring and the construction of itComparison-shopping I decided to get Graceland and I’m happy call Lance or contact him and he will definitely make sure you get taken care of and just make sure y’all understand. I am not paid for this endorsement.
And if anyone local can put in insulation for me and a ramp and possibly electricity, I would be very interested to get a And if anyone local can put in insulation,a ramp and possibly electricity, I would be very interested to get a IM from you.

Lance, I can’t thank you enough and just a footnote. He let me know that the concrete that’s supposed, to be holding my fence up with the metal post,There isn’t any there,was just a little bit of concrete right around the top,but most all of it had been cracked and worn away,so it was not holding the fence up. My fence is leaning terribly and I did not know till now concrete should’ve been a little deeper so fix that for us. I honestly have nightmares about my fence when the wind kicks up.!!!! thank you Lance the fee that you want is well worth it,from my peace of mind to sleep!!!
Thank you for your time and support and if anybody needs a building, go see Graceland portable and talk to Lance, so simple, so easy.
reviews.author: P. Ray

reviews.text: I was very pleased initially with the building,  sales process,  etc.  Until of course I had to cancel my order. It's been almost 2 months and I still haven't gotten my deposit back.  Now I question how well they would have stood by their product/warranty...

reviews.text: Bought a carport thats big enough to get out boat and rv under. Lance was excellent to work with and carport is very well built. Extremely happy with our purchase and Graceland.
reviews.author: jason jean

reviews.text: Lance, thank you for the AMAZING!!! Service, you exceeded my expectations and honestly if someone complains about this place there expectations are way too high, if your expecting to get a $60,000 building at this price well you are shopping in the wrong field go buy yourself a home. On time delivery and the driver was absolutely friendly. Thank you very much.

reviews.text: Great price, well built, and customer service is top notch. Answers any questions you have. They make sure you’re happy with their product. Highly recommend to anyone
reviews.author: Tripp Bernethy

reviews.text: Experience!!  Lets see I order a building 10/2/2020.. I canceled it within a hr or two.. Due to the building was to big.. Lance said he would cancel the order and I would have my money back in 7 yo 14 days...  22 days later I been trying to reach him and corporate office for the last week I have been getting the run around, of where my money is at and when I'm to get it back...  I finally reach someone to find out Mr. Lance just now sent in the cancel request yesterday so now I have to wait even Longer to get my money back.... Thats   Not good Buisness!!!!    Seem like he lied to get a commission check before he cancled it ... Smh. Now during hard times like now I'm hurting in bill wise due to lack of customer care and negligence on paperwork..      My opinion!

reviews.text: Graceland Portable Buildings, thank you so much for my super cute she shed I am in love with it. I really appreciate Lance for his help on this venture!

reviews.text: I have checked out several different places and this was the place I chose to get my storage building from because they had the best prices around within 200 miles from me and friendly staff and was so helpful with my needs and requirements they make sure you are happy with what you buy from them and that means a lot to me because money doesn't grow on trees , all I can say is this is the only place I would buy from again when it comes to a storage unit or vehicle covering.

data.summary: The reviews show mixed authenticity. Positive reviews contain some credible, detailed accounts but are mixed with generic praise and one biased review. Negative reviews are highly specific and form a clear pattern of issues with refunds and communication. The extremely low review volume across all platforms (31 total) is unusual for an established contractor and makes the overall rating picture less reliable.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (31 total) for an established business
Several 5-star reviews are generic and lack detail (e.g., 'Great experience')
One 5-star review is from an employee's family member (clear bias)
Multiple 3-4 star reviews have no text, preventing analysis
authentic_signals: Specific complaints with dates and names (Lance)
Detailed positive reviews mention construction specifics (double studs, tornado clips)
Varied writing styles and emotional tones across reviews
Complaints and praise both mention the same employee (Lance), adding credibility
data.discrepancy_explanation: Google rating (4.1) is significantly higher than Yelp (3.5), but Yelp has only 2 reviews, making the comparison unreliable. The low review volume on all platforms is a bigger concern than the rating difference.
